fields.System.Title: FDN-503 — Create a location with capacity
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator, I want to create a storage location with its capacity and
sequence, so that putaway can decide whether stock fits and picking can plan a route.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a zone, code, type, capacity, and pick sequence, when I create a location,
  • then it is created and active.
  • - Given a missing max weight or max volume, then creation is rejected — capacity is
  • required, not optional.
  • - Given a missing pick sequence, then creation is rejected.
  • - Given a location code, then it follows the configured naming pattern.
  • - Given a duplicate code within a warehouse, then it is rejected.
  • - Given the location, then its mixing rules (multiple products, multiple batches) are
  • recorded explicitly.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | masterdata |
| Tables | location |
| Risks | Null capacity breaks putaway suggestions ([doc 03 §7.4](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)); wrong sequence costs walking daily ([doc 03 §4](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
